title: Bath Water Punch
description: Make this weird-colored punch by stirring rainbow sherbet to a grey color and topping it with fruit drink mixes and pineapple soda. Garnish with plastic eye balls and fingers for Halloween!
ingredients: 1 (0.13 ounce) package black cherry-flavored fruit drink mix (such as KOOL-AID®)
1 (0.13 ounce) package orange-flavored fruit drink mix (such as KOOL-AID®)

steps.text: Scoop rainbow sherbet into a bowl; allow to sit at room temperature until it turns slushy..

Mix black cherry-flavored drink mix with sugar and water in a pitcher; stir until sugar is dissolved. Add orange-flavored drink mix; stir well. Pour into a punch bowl. Top with pineapple soda; stir well.
Stir the rainbow sherbet with a wooden spoon until it turns a grayish color. Scoop into the punch bowl. Stir slowly to break up the sherbet.
